old: और अमानुषों में भी यह देखा जाता है।
new: और मनुष्येतरों में भी यह देखा जाता है।
why: reviewer (minor): Hindi अमानुष commonly means 'inhuman, cruel'; the Sanskrit amānuṣa here is 'non-human' (beings other than humans). The Hindi would invite the wrong sense.

old: “क्योंकि वे उसके सब को रोककर स्वामी के समान आचरण करते हैं।
new: “क्योंकि वे उसके सब कुछ को रोककर स्वामी के समान आचरण करते हैं।
why: reviewer (minor): sarvam is neuter 'everything'; Hindi 'सब को' reads as 'all (persons)'. Keep the neuter sense without adding a noun.

old: Therefore [one] should make ministers endowed with high birth, wisdom, purity, valour and attachment, because of the primacy of qualities.”
new: Therefore [one] should make ministers endowed with high birth, insight, purity, valour and attachment, because of the primacy of qualities.”
why: reviewer (minor): Glossary (1.5): prajñā = insight (प्रज्ञा); the English must match.

old: endowed with high birth, wisdom, purity, valour, attachment
